data.label: Synthetic user (browser)
data.description: Synthetic test user signing in through a browser. This is a client reference and is not provisioned.

data.label: Sign-in
data.description: Issues OIDC tokens to synthetic users. The app validates the tokens and derives the user ID from the token subject.

data.label: Chat application
data.description: Web UI and chat API. Rejects unauthenticated requests, loads and saves per-user history, builds the bounded prompt, calls the model and returns the reply. It has no tools for external actions.

data.label: Conversation state
data.description: Stores per-user conversation documents, partitioned by the token subject. The app can only read and write the signed-in user's own partition. Retention is still to be decided.

data.label: Bounded context builder
data.description: Application logic owned by the Chat application, not a separate deployment. It limits history turns, input size and output tokens, and treats stored content as untrusted.

data.label: Model runtime
data.description: Foundation model inference via the watsonx.ai API using a service ID. The model, plan, region and access are unverified. Local tests use a scripted mock instead.

data.label: Escalation
data.description: The app publishes an escalation event when the user asks for a person or the model abstains. The event goes to the reviewer's destination.

data.label: Human reviewer
data.description: The person who receives escalated conversations. Not provisioned.

data.label: Logs & audit
data.description: Application logs, escalation audit and account activity. Retention is still to be decided.

brief.application: Use IBM Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Build an authenticated conversational assistant for synthetic users. Include an application, per-user conversation state, model runtime, bounded context and an escalation path. No external actions in this first test. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.ibm-conversational-assistant-first-end-to-end-sketch
decisions.title: IBM conversational assistant – first end-to-end sketch
decisions.context: Scope: an authenticated chat for synthetic users with per-user state, bounded context, watsonx.ai runtime and human escalation. No external actions. Assumptions: region not selected; watsonx.ai model, plan and account access are unverified. No native Terraform generator exists for this IBM path yet, so engineering is still required. The context limiter is application logic inside Code Engine.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Only authenticated users can chat. Each user can read and continue only their own conversation history, and unknown or invalid tokens are rejected.
needs.rationale: Prevents one user's conversations from leaking to another user.

needs.statement: Proposed: each model call has limits on history turns, input size and output tokens. No external actions are performed.
needs.rationale: Controls cost, latency and prompt-injection exposure. The limit values are still to be confirmed.
needs.basis: "bounded context" and "No external actions in this first test"

needs.statement: Proposed: an explicit request for a person, or a model abstention, creates an escalation that is notified to a human reviewer and audited.
needs.rationale: Gives users a safe fallback when the assistant cannot help. The exact triggers need confirmation.
